purpose: acquire only the sources fixed by the locked STEP 37 protocol (field 15 / 37-42) for the immutable STEP 36 cohort, verify provenance and integrity, and freeze the data; no daily field, composite, trajectory, metric, endpoint, bootstrap or comparison

NCEP.access: PSL THREDDS NCSS (STEP 17 wind_parts; request longitudes converted to the PSL 0..360 request convention as in STEP 17; the frozen runtime unwraps longitudes at lookup)

GLORYS.access: official Copernicus Marine toolbox in the STEP 25B isolated venv; credentials by exit code only
GLORYS.version: recorded from the file at acquisition

WW3.product: WW3 GLOB-30M CFSR surface Stokes drift (uuss/vuss), IFREMER hindcast, product_version 1.0
WW3.access: ftp://ftp.ifremer.fr/ifremer/ww3/HINDCAST/GLOBAL/2010_CFSR/uss/ (anonymous FTP; own fetch, no shared log)

step37ForcingRule: if any registered source is unavailable or a mandatory frame is missing for a window: WINDOW_BLOCKED for that window in every condition; no alternative product, version, interpolation or reconstruction; if the Copernicus credential check fails: CANDIDATE_BLOCKED (H1 not evaluable), H2 may still proceed on A/B
substitution: FORBIDDEN (no other product, experiment, version, interpolation or reconstruction)
longitudeRule: STEP 37 field 20: STEP 36 boxes are -180..180; the reader axis must cover the box in that convention; any convention mismatch -> COORDINATE_BLOCKED, never transformed; probe (2010-07-27T12Z, box slice) showed the NCSS returns -180..180 for this dataset
immutability: originals never overwritten (fetch refuses existing files); derived runtime datasets stored under normalized/ and linked to the original SHA-256; freeze manifest classifies A original / B derived / C metadata / D log
blockingRule: missing registered frame -> WINDOW_BLOCKED (all conditions); GLORYS unavailable / credential failure -> CANDIDATE_BLOCKED for that window; WW3 file unavailable -> CANDIDATE_BLOCKED for windows in that month; never substitute
